title: Floor-level space steps short-cycle where the floor lift exceeds min lift plus stop hysteresis
claim: Under a pump with an integrating speed loop and a 2 K stop hysteresis, a step booked at the modulation floor (min-cold-tank, 1.0 kW) runs 30 starts in 2.5 h at 0.60 kW on a plant lifting 8 K/kW (38 starts, 0.50 kW at 10 K/kW) against the plan's one run at 1.0 kW; the power-feedback loop never corrects it.
mechanism: The floor writes inlet + flow_min_lift_k (5 K); a pump whose water at its floor sits higher than that plus its stop hysteresis stops and restarts. `_feedback` resets its run on every stop and folds only running samples, so its windowed error is 0 (running at the floor = the booked floor) and `_nudged` stays in the deadband; the duty-cycle shortfall is never seen.

evidence.unit: compressor starts over 2.5 h of floor steps (plan: 1), k_lift 8
evidence.machine: box B11 (shared container, Linux 6.18, ~/venv-ci Python 3.14.7, hastub)

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.pump_arbiter:_flow_target and _feedback (via pump_arbiter.apply on the one-minute tick)

perturbation.observed_value: 1 start at k_lift 8 (1.0 kW), 4 at 10 (0.98 kW)

metric_definition: pump-model compressor starts and mean draw over steps 3..10 of a floor-level stretch, against the plan's one run at power_schedule[k]
phenomenon_property: A step the plan books at the modulation floor is realized as one continuous run at the floor on any plant the loop can hold there: the set-point loop sees a duty-cycle shortfall, not only running samples.

null_control.note: k_lift 2.0-6.5: 1 start at 1.0 kW each (the null plant k 5: power_error 0)

reproduction_steps: effect.py: RESULT min-cold-tank_k8.0_starts=30 measured_kw=0.602; k10.0_starts=38 measured_kw=0.5; k2.0-6.5 starts=1
proposed_fix_scope: pump_arbiter feedback: count a stopped minute inside a booked heating step as a zero sample (or keep the run across a short stop) so the loop lifts the floor target; or learn the floor lift from the supply-temperature reading.
